# Campaignify

> Campaignify (campaignify.ai) is one workspace for launching and running a marketing campaign from start to finish, built for small brands and independent sellers. An AI planner turns a brief into angles, hooks, scripts, ads and a launch checklist; the ad studio turns a product photo into image and video ads; and the rest of the campaign (copy, SEO and AI-answer audits, ad-account setup, landing pages, smart links, forms, contacts and a community) lives in the same place. Every brief, piece of copy and landing page is checked for income, health, discount and recruiting claims.

## How a campaign runs in Campaignify
{% for s in journey %}
{{ loop.index }}. {{ s.step }}: {{ s.body }}{% endfor %}

Campaignify doesn't post ads or read results from ad platforms. It guides ad-account setup and exports each ad at the platform's sizes; you launch the ads in each platform's ads manager. Its analytics cover the pages, smart links and forms you run on Campaignify.

- [Home]({{ request.host_url }}): the campaign steps, example ads, compliance checks, pricing and FAQ.

## Plans

{% for p in plans.PAID %}- {{ p.name }}: ${{ p.usd }} a month, {{ '{:,}'.format(p.credits) }} credits a month.
{% endfor %}- Free: starter credits and the ad studio. Credit packs ($29, $79, $199) top up any account.
- 1 credit = $0.01. Plan credits expire at each renewal; pack credits never expire.
